channel.title: Aston Martin Aramco F1 — official news
channel.description: Official Aston Martin Aramco F1 team stories and announcements.

item.title: Jessica Hawkins: Eyeing a championship-winning weekend
item.description: As the British GT4 Championship reaches its conclusion, Jessica Hawkins reflects on being in a title race that's going down to the wire.

item.title: How AI on CoreWeave is transforming the way Aston Martin Aramco competes in F1
item.description: Eric Ernst explores how AI is driving innovation, and how CoreWeave is helping Aston Martin Aramco, before he speaks at Fully Connected.

item.title: Ella Lähdemaa: Finding confidence in the F1 ACADEMY Rookie Test
item.description: Ella Lähdemaa reflects on being selected by Aston Martin Aramco to represent the team at the F1 ACADEMY Rookie Test.

item.title: A seat at the table
item.description: Step inside the Aston Martin Aramco hospitality experience at the Italian Grand Prix, with one of Milan's most iconic restaurants: Veramente.

item.title: F1 2027 calendar revealed – everything you need to know
item.description: The 2027 Formula One calendar has been confirmed with 24 races between March and December

item.title: Five things you can't teach an F1 mechanic
item.description: Our mechanics know the car inside out, but there are some things that can't be taught. We spoke to them to learn about the value of experience.

item.title: Some assembly required – the mechanics building our F1 cars before they reach the track
item.description: Head of Build and Car Assembly Mark Gray takes us behind the scenes to reveal the experience and precision required to prepare a race-ready car.

item.title: Aston Martin Aramco nominates Ella Lähdemaa for 2026 F1 ACADEMY Rookie Test
item.description: Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team is pleased to announce its nomination of Ella Lähdemaa for the 2026 F1 ACADEMY Rookie Test and Training Camp.

item.title: UNDERCUT | An espresso with Enrico Cardile
item.description: Chief Technical Officer Enrico Cardile opens up about development, pressure, patience, process, and what it takes to keep moving forward.

item.title: Behind the pass: How Aston Martin Aramco is reimagining the culinary experience in the F1 paddock
item.description: What happens when great restaurants meet the F1 paddock? Aston Martin Aramco is finding out. Max Coen is the latest chef to take over The House kitchen.

item.title: Jenson's Journal | Entry 04: Fernando's future, knowing when to leave F1, and living in Italy's 'City of Steel'
item.description: Jenson Button picks up his pen for the latest entry in Jenson's Journal. He reflects on racing in Italy and offers his take on Fernando Alonso's future.

item.title: Driven By Sound: Aston Martin Aramco x Defected Records
item.description: Four days, one London pop-up, live sets, an I / AM DROP and the coming together of two communities. We're celebrating F1 and house music, Driven By Sound.

item.title: Robert Wood Johnson acquires stake in Aston Martin Aramco
item.description: Robert Wood Johnson acquires a strategic minority stake in the Company and will join the Board of Directors as Vice Chairman.

item.title: Meet the Creator Collective: Eloise Feely is bringing her love of golf to the grid
item.description: Golfer and content creator Eloise Feely is one of the new additions to the Aston Martin Aramco TikTok Creator Collective.

item.title: Meet the Creator Collective: Kiera Rockley is bringing a whole new meaning to ‘green’ fingers
item.description: Kiera Rockley, who loves to mix floral design with Formula One, has joined the TikTok Creator Collective for season two.

item.title: Meet the Creator Collective: Debbie Kande is in her 'yes' era
item.description: As part of season two of the TikTok Creator Collective, Debbie is documenting everything she loves, from race tracks to boxing rings.

item.title: Mathilda Paatz: In Michael Schumacher's wheel tracks
item.description: Mathilda Paatz reflects on her journey from karting at Michael Schumacher's circuit and supporting her father at the Nürburgring to winning in F1 ACADEMY.

item.title: Cohere joins Aston Martin Aramco as Official Generative AI Partner to help accelerate AI innovation
item.description: Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team announces a new multi-year partnership with leading security-first enterprise AI company Cohere.

item.title: Downforce in a dram: Meet the Adrian Newey of whisky, Brian Kinsman
item.description: We explore the genius of Glenfiddich's master of malt, Brian Kinsman, drawing natural comparisons with another master of his craft: Adrian Newey.

item.title: An unrelenting thrill: Surpassing everything a fan has ever experienced at the Italian Grand Prix
item.description: How we took an I / AM member's Italian Grand Prix from standstill to 60mph in 3.3 seconds in the Aston Martin Vantage S.
